title: Ensure the repository publishes a security policy (SECURITY.md)
description: A security policy tells whoever finds a flaw where to send it and what to expect. Without one, reports either go nowhere or go public.
remediation: Add a SECURITY.md at the repository root (or under .github/) on the default branch, stating the contact address for reports, which versions are supported, and the expected response time. Adjust which paths count with securityPolicyPaths in scm-bench's config.
remediationZh: 在默认分支的仓库根目录（或 .github/ 下）添加 SECURITY.md，写明漏洞报告联系方式、受支持的版本范围与预期响应时间。可通过 scm-bench 配置项 securityPolicyPaths 调整识别路径。
